commits.summary: Record the Spring Boot S01-S50 setup reruns and queue eight more setup build jobs (verification pending)
commits.body:
The 41 setup build jobs rerun after the second resolution pass came back: 36 passed every step (the landed tests pass at the fix, the parent's at the parent, and the fix's tests fail or do not compile on a copy of the parent), so 43 of the 49 Gradle cases are now complete with their artifacts and digests in the setup record. S11 and S12 failed only because the fix's tests also pass on the parent; these are recorded as results, like S46, and not rerun. Three were setup faults, now fixed in the setup's own scripts (no upstream or repository code changed): S24 and S30 could not compile spring-boot-micrometer-metrics under -Werror because the only Micrometer 1.18.0 snapshot still served deprecates the AppOptics registry, so an init script drops -Werror for that one project; S32 named an abstract test class, which a --tests filter never matches, so the job now names its three concrete subclasses (S33 too). The per-class JUnit summary also missed long class names, because Gradle 9 hashes XML file names over 120 bytes; it now matches each file's testsuite name, checked on made-up files.
